name: io.github.2016judea/paris-fashion-archive
title: Paris Fashion Archive
description: Find any 1920–1954 issue of Vogue Paris digitised by the BnF; see covers and pages up to 1930

tools.name: find_issues
tools.description: Lists Vogue Paris issues (1920-1954) by year, month or date range, each with its date, page count and a link to read it on https://vogue-paris.vercel.app. With no filters it returns how many issues each year holds. images_available is true for issues from 1930 and earlier (US public domain). Examples: {"year": 1925}; {"from": "1926-03-01", "to": "1926-06-30"}; {"month": 12}.

month.description: Month of the year, 1-12, across all years

tools.name: look_at_covers
tools.description: Returns the covers of Vogue Paris issues as images, with each issue's date and reader link, up to 12 at a time. Covers are returned for issues from 1930 and earlier (US public domain); a later year returns its issue list and links only. Examples: {"year": 1925}; {"from": "1927-01-01", "to": "1927-06-30"}; {"issues": ["1920-06-15", "1926-03"]}.

issues.description: Specific issues instead of a year or range

items.description: An issue date ("1925-06-15"), a month ("1925-06", nearest issue that month) or a Gallica ark ("bpt6k9604118j")

tools.name: look_at_pages
tools.description: Returns pages of one Vogue Paris issue as images, up to 4 at a time, so they can be read, described or translated from the French. Page 1 is the cover, counted the way the site's reader counts. Each page also gets a link to a 2400-pixel scan. Pages are returned for issues from 1930 and earlier (US public domain); a later issue returns its details and reader link only. Examples: {"issue": "1925-06-15", "pages": [1, 2, 3]}; {"issue": "1922-03", "pages": [10, 11]}.

issue.description: An issue date ("1925-06-15"), a month ("1925-06", nearest issue that month) or a Gallica ark ("bpt6k9604118j")

tools.name: vogue_cover_on_date
tools.description: The Vogue Paris cover from a given date: a birthday, an anniversary, a month in history. A full date or a month returns the issue on or nearest that date (within two months). A month and day with no year ("06-15") returns the issue nearest that day in every year the archive holds. Covers come back as images for 1930 and earlier; later issues get their date and reader link. Example questions: "Vogue cover from the day my grandmother was born, 1927-04-02"; "what was on Vogue in March 1925"; "Vogue covers on my birthday, 15 June".

date.description: "1927-04-02", "1925-03", or "06-15" for that day in every year

tools.name: vogue_covers_by_decade
tools.description: Vogue Paris covers from one decade: the 1920s (flappers, Art Deco), the 1930s, the 1940s (wartime and the New Look) or the early 1950s. Returns up to 12 covers spread evenly across the decade as images, with the decade's issue count. Covers are images for 1930 and earlier; later decades return the issue list with reader links. Example questions: "1920s Vogue covers"; "Art Deco fashion magazine covers"; "Vogue in the 1940s".

tools.name: vogue_by_season
tools.description: Vogue Paris issues from one season of one year (spring = March-May, summer = June-August, autumn = September-November, winter = December and the January-February after it), with covers as images for 1930 and earlier. The Paris collections were shown in spring and autumn, so those issues carry the new season's fashions. Example questions: "what was in fashion in spring 1925"; "Vogue's autumn 1928 collections"; "winter 1922 Vogue".

year.description: The year (for winter, the year its December falls in)

tools.name: translate_vogue_page
tools.description: Returns pages of a Vogue Paris issue as images in the original French, up to 4 at a time, for reading and translation into English or any language. Where the site has already transcribed a page, its French text and an English translation come back with it (marked machine-made). Page 1 is the cover. Pages are returned for issues from 1930 and earlier; later issues get the reader link. Example questions: "translate page 3 of the 1 July 1920 Vogue"; "what does this 1925 Vogue ad say in English"; "read me the French on the cover of June 1922".

issue.description: An issue date ("1925-06-15"), a month ("1925-06", nearest issue that month) or a Gallica ark ("bpt6k9604118j")

tools.name: random_vintage_vogue_cover
tools.description: One Vogue Paris cover picked at random from the public-domain years (1920-1930), or from a narrower span of years, returned as an image with its date and reader link. Example questions: "a random vintage Vogue cover"; "surprise me with a 1920s fashion cover"; "a Vogue cover of the day".

tools.name: can_i_use_vogue_images
tools.description: US copyright status of a Vogue Paris issue or year: whether it is in the US public domain, the statute behind it, and the year a later issue enters it. A work published in year Y enters the US public domain on 1 January of Y + 96 (17 U.S.C. 304); the 1931-1954 French issues had US copyright restored (17 U.S.C. 104A). Covers US law only; other countries' terms are not worked out here. Not legal advice. Example questions: "are 1920s Vogue covers public domain"; "can I print and sell a 1928 Vogue cover"; "when does the 1947 Vogue enter the public domain".

issue.description: An issue date ("1925-06-15"), a month ("1925-06", nearest issue that month) or a Gallica ark ("bpt6k9604118j")

tools.name: high_resolution_vogue_cover
tools.description: Links to the 2400-pixel scan of a Vogue Paris cover (or any page), for a print, a poster, a wallpaper or a mood board, plus a preview image and the credit line. Scans are given for issues from 1930 and earlier (US public domain); later issues get the reader link. Example questions: "high-res 1925 Vogue cover to print"; "download a vintage Vogue cover for a poster"; "Vogue cover wallpaper".

issue.description: An issue date ("1925-06-15"), a month ("1925-06", nearest issue that month) or a Gallica ark ("bpt6k9604118j")
